issue.body:
It would be really nice to have a virtual hosts support (like with tornado) : 

> We support virtual hosts with the `add_handlers` method, which takes in a host regular expression as the first argument:
> 
> ```
> application.add_handlers(r"www\.myhost\.com", [
>     (r"/article/([0-9]+)", ArticleHandler),
> ])
> ```
> If there’s no match for the current request’s host, then default_host parameter value is matched against host regular expressions.

I've seen some references to a `base_url` variable in the code, but it doesn't seem possible to actively set it.

The point is to have only one instance of `uvicorn` with one instance of `Starlette` but being able to handle multiple domains or subdomains.
issue.title: Support virtual hosts
